title: The Convergence of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji gripped the Jade Pendant bearing his father's fate, a golden rift tore open in the Void—a gaze surpassing the Heavenly Dao, dominating all things, regarding him with irresistible will. The ultimate confrontation of destiny is about to unfold completely upon these ruins.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's figure solidified in the Void, those ancient yet profound eyes reflecting the yellowed Jade Pendant in Chen Ji's hand—'Young Master, your father Chen Tianming... will return in three months.' The words exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's Mental Sea. His fingers gripping the pendant trembled slightly, yet he forced himself to maintain the usual calm of atrash disciple. Mo Xiansheng's voice continued: 'But before his return, you must complete one final task—unite the five pages of the Tianji Record.'

dialogue.content: 'Unite five pages?' Chen Ji raised his head, a flash of brilliance in those seemingly murky eyes. 'Does the master mean... the first page of remnant soul, the second page of prophecy, the third page of karma, the fourth page of reincarnation, plus this fifth page—'

'Correct.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul radiated a faint glow. 'The fifth page—the Pen of Destiny. Only by gathering all five pages can you possess the true power to write fate. But this also means you will face the final scrutiny of the Heavenly Eye.'

text.content: Before the words finished, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's arms shuddered violently. Yellowed pages fluttered without wind, five beams of light shot from the book, interweaving in the Void to form a complex formation diagram. That was—the five fragments were assembling themselves. Chen Ji felt a mighty power awakening within him, the talent suppressed for years finally releasing at this moment.

dialogue.content: 'So from the beginning, this was my father's arrangement?' Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying traces of sarcasm and relief. 'Let me be atrash, let Tianqing Sect abandon me, let everyone despise me—just so the Heavenly Eye would overlook this chess piece of his?'

'You've only gotten half of it right.' A complex expression flickered in Mo Xiansheng's eyes. 'Chen Tianming laid his plans for twenty years, but the one thing he didn't account for was—that you would go further than him. Young Master, now you have two paths to choose from.'

text.content: As Mo Xiansheng spoke, the five pages of the Tianji Record unified completely. An unprecedented power flooded Chen Ji's Mental Sea. He 'saw' countless threads of fate—some leading to light, some plunging into abyss, with two particularly dazzling ones: one radiating golden holy light, the other entwined by black destiny.

dialogue.content: 'The first path—break the chains.' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew solemn. 'Completely destroy the Heavenly Eye's control over fate, granting freedom to all imprisoned seers. But the price is—you may be destroyed alongside Heaven and Earth.'

'The second path—replace Heaven.' Mo Xiansheng's gaze turned sharp. 'Using the Tianji Record as a medium, devour the Heavenly Eye's authority, become the new ruler of destiny. But on this path, you will gradually lose all emotional bonds, transforming into无情 rules themselves.'

text.content: At this moment, the Tianji Record's image blurred for an instant—Chen Ji saw Chen Nian's figure, trapped in a golden cage, gazing at the Void with those eyes identical to his own. 'Niannian...' Chen Ji murmured, his heart anguish. Mo Xiansheng sighed: 'This is prophecy with her in it—always blurred. But precisely because of this, she is the key to breaking these two宿命 paths.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul floated quietly, awaiting Chen Ji's choice. Two paths of fate have unfolded—one leading to destruction and freedom, one to power and solitude. In the distance, the countdown to Chen Tianming's return has begun. Three threads are about to converge, and Chen Ji must decide.

choices.description: Choose the path of mutual destruction with the Heavenly Eye, trading destruction for all seers' freedom. This is the most tragic yet purest ending.
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, may lead to eternal damnation
choices.process_label: chen ji chooses the most dangerous path

text.content: 'I choose the first path.' Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. 'Break the chains.' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, complex emotions showing both worry and relief: 'Are you certain? This means—'

choices.risk_hint: The price is becoming the ruthless Heavenly Dao itself

text.content: 'I will replace Heaven.' Chen Ji's eyes ignited with flames of ambition. 'Since it can control fate, then I shall take its place. Let everyone dance upon my chessboard—including it.'

choices.description: Refuse to choose between destruction and solitude, forcefully carve out a brand new path. This requires paying an enormous price, but may bring unexpected gains.
choices.visible_reward: New possibilities beyond the two fates

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed, that smile carrying his usual calculation and madness: 'Who says there are only two paths? Master, I refuse to choose from your options. My fate—'

dialogue.content: 'My fate, I myself shall write.' Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record forcefully, the power of unified five pages surging within him. He felt an unprecedented sense of fullness—this wasn't simply getting stronger, but truly touching the threads of fate. In the distance, commotion came from Tianqing Sect's direction. A slight smile curved Chen Ji's lips: 'Here they come.'

text.content: A black rift suddenly tore across the sky, a surge of boundless demonic energy swept over. Mo Xiansheng's expression shifted slightly: 'The Demonic Path commander has arrived personally.' Immediately after, golden imperial banners appeared on the horizon's other side. Three factions, like three arrows aimed at the same target, were converging upon these ruins. And Chen Ji, standing at the storm's center, calmly awaited fate's convergence.

dialogue.content: A black figure descended from the heavens. Ye Qing appeared before Chen Ji. Her face carried unprecedented gravity: 'Chen Ji, I sense—the Heavenly Eye is watching here. It knows you have obtained the complete inheritance.' She paused, complex emotions flickering in her eyes. 'You... are you truly ready?'

choice.prompt: Representatives of the three factions are gathering, the Heavenly Eye's gaze like thorns on the back. Facing the approaching final confrontation, Chen Ji needs to make final preparations.

choices.description: Receive all enemies with dignified force, displaying true strength. Let everyone witness thetrash's counterattack.
choices.visible_reward: Shock the entire audience, reputation soaring

dialogue.content: 'Perfectly suits my心意.' Chen Ji stepped forward, the Tianji Record's power forming a faint halo around him. 'Since we must fight, let the entire world see clearly—who is the true chess master.'

choices.description: Continue playing thetrash, wait for enemies to reveal weaknesses. This is Chen Ji's most skilled strategy of playing pig to eat the tiger.
choices.visible_reward: Set up in darkness, strike after enemy attacks

dialogue.content: 'Not yet.' Chen Ji's gaze deepened. 'Let them fight first. The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind—now what I need isn't victory, but to let all hidden cards see their opponents clearly.'

'Chen Ji!' Su Qingyao's voice called from the distance. Her figure shot over like lightning, landing at Chen Ji's side. Her eyes held worry, and a trace of indefinable tenderness: 'I sensed abnormal spiritual fluctuations in heaven and earth, you—' She suddenly stopped, because she saw the Tianji Record radiating complete light in Chen Ji's hand.

text.content: Su Qingyao's breath hitched. That Jade Slip radiating complete light, that profound aura even she couldn't probe—all her doubts collapsed completely at this moment. Gazing at Chen Ji's calm, still-water eyes, she suddenly understood. This man she had investigated for three years, whom she had been fooled by again and again, had indeed been acting from the beginning. And now, he no longer needed to perform.

dialogue.content: 'So... from the beginning, you were never anytrash.' Su Qingyao's voice carried a hint of bitterness, even more so was it relieved. 'And I chased you for three years, chasing not the truth—but the illusion you deliberately let me see.' She suddenly smiled, that smile carrying frustration but more so a strange admiration. 'Chen Ji, you really are...让人恨得牙痒.'

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao finally uncovered Chen Ji's true face. Three years of pursuit ends here. In the distance, conflict among the three factions is on the verge of erupting.

choices.description: Confess everything to Su Qingyao, establish a true trust alliance. This is a key turning point in the emotional line.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's complete trust and support

dialogue.content: 'Correct, I performed thetrash for ten years.' Chen Ji turned to face Su Qingyao. 'But there's one thing I never lied to you about—my trust in you was always real.'

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶建立了真正的信任

choices.description: Only reveal part of the truth, maintain mystery. This is Chen Ji's usual style.

dialogue.content: 'Senior Sister Su, the less you know about certain things, the safer it is for you.' Chen Ji turned away, his voice faint. 'A lot will happen next. You only need to know—I won't let anything happen to Tianqing Sect.'

text.content: At this moment, the heavens and earth suddenly darkened. An authority surpassing all mortal comprehension descended from the Void. Everyone raised their heads in unison—above that firmament, a giant golden eye was slowly opening. That was no one's eye, but Heaven's own gaze, the Heavenly Dao's final warning to those daring to touch the forbidden. Chen Ji clenched his fist, the Tianji Record's power roared within him. 'So it's finally here?' A cold smile curved his lips. 'Then let us see—who's Heavenly Dao is stronger, or whose chess game is more exquisite!'

dialogue.content: An ice-cold voice resounded in everyone's Mental Sea. That voice carried no emotion, yet caused all to feel bone-deep chill: 'Chen Ji, heir of the Tianji Record. You have touched the forbidden edge. Make your choice now—surrender the Tianji Record, and this one may spare your life; or—' The voice paused. 'Together with all who would resist fate, be reduced to nothingness.'

text.content: Faced with the Heavenly Eye's threat, Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter. That laughter echoed across the ruins, filled with sarcasm and defiance. 'Reduced to nothingness?' He raised the Tianji Record, the unified five pages' light illuminating heaven and earth. 'Heavenly Eye, do you think I came this far to hear your threats? In three months, my father returns; in three years, I will find my sister; and now—' He took a deep breath. 'My fate, I myself shall write!'

The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the entire heavens and earth changed color. Representatives of the three factions witnessed a scene they would never forget—that disciple calledtrash, under the Heavenly Eye's gaze, declared his sovereignty without a trace of fear. What shocked even more was that in the heavens above, beside that golden eye, another eye slowly manifested—an eye surpassing Heavenly Dao, an existence even the Heavenly Eye could not comprehend. The ultimate confrontation of fate had officially begun.
